title: Annotatio IV §.XVI: yet true presence asserted — confession ~1200; who does not eat Christ’s body is not saved
pass_a_gloss: BY WHICH the ASSERTED TRUE PRESENCE OF CHRIST’S BODY IN THE SACRED SUPPER is clear from their more ancient Confession written around the year 1200, in Hoveden’s Annals fol. 319, in which they say: We believe that he is not saved who does not eat the body of Christ,
pass_b_english: Yet they also assert true presence of Christ’s body in the Sacred Supper.
Ancient confession ~1200 (Hoveden fol. 319): We believe he is not saved who does not eat the body of Christ.
source_text: QUA ASSERTAM VERAM CORPORIS CHRISTI IN S. CŒNA PRÆSENTIAM, ex Confessione eorum antiquiori, circa annum 1200. scripta, apud Hovedenum in Annalibus fol. 319. constat, in qua dicunt: Credimus, quod non salvatur, qui non manducat corpus Christi,

lemmas.gloss: is not saved who does not eat

choices.english: not saved who does not eat
rejected: not salvaged who does not manducate
